g.title: Case_B3_Figure2
g.text: Figure B3-2. Fixation after Info/LCD-active overlap from LCD-docked states

g.title: b_note
g.text: Info display enters an LCD-active shooting context (S5 or S6).
After this overlap, closing the LCD and power cycling can lead to fixation,
which becomes apparent when the LCD is opened again.

g.title: key_info_bottom
g.text: Grey background: Info display is shown

g.title: key_LCD_bottom
g.text: Purple border: LCD is in an active shooting context

g.title: key_info_top
g.text: Grey background: Info display is shown

g.title: key_LCD_top
g.text: Purple border: LCD is in an active shooting context
